hook_text: Fold a rectangle corner to corner. Is that a line of symmetry? The flaps say no.
clip_script: Craft market in Pretoria! This beadwork panel: fold it down the middle. The halves match. A line of symmetry! Now a rectangle. Fold it corner to corner. Flaps stick out! Not symmetry. Fold side to side: perfect. So a rectangle has 2 lines. A square has 4. The stop sign has 8, one for every side. And a circle? Every diameter works. Too many to count!
visual_style: Colourful beadwork and shapes folding in 3D, with a glowing mirror line and flaps that pop out on the wrong folds.
mood: Bright and surprising, like a magic trick.
pacing: Quick folds, a pause on the failed diagonal fold, then rapid counts.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and count the lines of symmetry in your name.
